file_id: Preeyam Yadav And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 May, 2024

sentences.text:
Preeyam Yadav And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on
15 May, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Court No. - 88
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 36629 of 2023
Applicant :- Preeyam Yadav And 4 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Mahesh Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Ashok Kumar Yadav,G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Ashok Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the
opposite party no. 2 and learned Aga for the State.

2.  This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants for quashing the charge-sheet dated 23.11.2020 including cognizance order dated 24.06.2022, as well as, entire proceedings of Case No. 12277 of 2022 registered with Case Crime No. 393 of 2020 under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Premnagar, District Jhansi.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have entered into a compromise.

4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 submits that the parties have entered into compromise and he would have no objection in case criminal proceedings against the applicant(s)
are quashed.

Preeyam Yadav And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124697598/
1 4-A.

entities.text: Preeyam Yadav And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. submits that the compromise effected between the parties may be verified before the court concerned.

5. In the interest of justice, the applicants and the opposite party no.2 are directed to appear before the court concerned on 10.07.2024 and shall submit the compromise, which shall be verified by the court concerned and a report in this regard shall be submitted before this Court within 15 days thereafter.

6. List on 2nd August 2024, in top ten cases.
7.

Till the next date of listing, further proceedings in the aforesaid case shall remain stayed in respect of applicant(s)-Preeyam Yadav, Archana, Lokendra Singh, Rishu Yadav @ Rishabh Yadav and Ragani Yadav.

Order Date :- 15.5.2024 S.Prakash  Preeyam Yadav And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124697598/
